text:
Jackie’s opportunity cost when she does the taxes herself is  

\[
3\text{ hrs}\times \$35/\text{hr}= \$105 .
\]

If she hires an accountant she pays a flat fee of \$90, but she can still work those 3 freelance hours and earn the \$105.

The extra amount she will have by hiring the accountant is  

\[
\$105 - \$90 = \$15 .
\]

**Final answer: 15**
